verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const read=(f)=>fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8");const walk=(d)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(d))return[];return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((x)=>{const p=path.join(d,x.name);return x.isDirectory()?(x.name==="node_modules"?[]:walk(p)):[p]})};const v1=()=>walk("app/api/v1").filter((f)=>/route\.ts$/.test(f));const v1src=()=>v1().map(read).join("\n");const s=v1src();if(!/@\/lib\/engagement\/capture/.test(s))fail("no /api/v1 endpoint captures a node, so a native QR, NFC or geofence capture has nowhere to land");if(!/nodes_geo|node_within_range/.test(s))fail("no nearby-nodes endpoint for the app to register geofences from");console.log("ok")'

append.detail: 2026-10-06: POST /api/v1/nodes/{id}/capture runs the web's captureNode for the verified caller (secret, location; attestation accepted, not yet verified); GET /api/v1/nodes/nearby lists live nodes from nodes_geo through lib/engagement/nearby.ts, nearest first, capped at 20 within 5 km, never a secret, Ghost points rounded to about 110 m. The NFC payload rule (NDEF URI of the same /n/<id>?s= link) is in docs/APP-CONTRACT.md §12. Tested in lib/engagement/nearby.test.ts and app/api/v1/nodes/nearby/route.test.ts.
